63740-a-letter-on-the-late-post-office-a.creator: Unknown
63740-a-letter-on-the-late-post-office-a.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The measure now impugned (the transmission, namely, of certain provincial and foreign letters through London on the Sunday) is not an isolated one. It is but one part of a more general scheme. And what is the object of that scheme, as described in the minute referred to? {5}  _The reduction of the Sunday duties of the Post Office_.

arxiv-1810-06412.title: Algol as Horus in the Cairo Calendar: the possible means and the motives of the observations
arxiv-1810-06412.creator: *, Lauri Jetsu, Tapio Markkanen, Joonas Lyytinen, Perttu Kajatkari, Jyri Lehtinen, Jaana Toivari-Viitala
arxiv-1810-06412.description: Abstract An ancient Egyptian Calendar of Lucky and Unlucky Days, the Cairo Calendar (CC), assigns luck with the period of 2.850 days. Previous astronomical, astrophysical and statistical analyses of CC support the idea that this was the period of the eclipsing binary Algol three millennia ago.

arxiv-2101-02977.title: Environments of a sample of AzTEC submillimetre galaxies in the COSMOS field
arxiv-2101-02977.creator: N. Álvarez Crespo, V. Smolc̆ić, A. Finoguenov, L. Barrufet and M. Aravena
arxiv-2101-02977.description: Abstract Aims. Submillimetre galaxies (SMGs) are bright sources at submillimetre wavelengths ( F 850 ​ μ ​ m > F_{850\mu m}> 2 - 5 mJy). Made up of mostly of high-z galaxies ( z > z> 1), SMGs are amongst the most luminous dusty galaxies in the Universe.

arxiv-2103-12097.title: The Hubbard Model Journal: Submitted to Annual Review of Condensed Matter Physics
arxiv-2103-12097.creator: Daniel P. Arovas 1, Erez Berg 2, Steven A. Kivelson 3, Srinivas Raghu 3,4
arxiv-2103-12097.description: Abstract The repulsive Hubbard model has been immensely useful in understanding strongly correlated electron systems, and serves as the paradigmatic model of the field. Despite its simplicity, it exhibits a strikingly rich phenomenology which is reminiscent of that observed in quantum materials. Nevertheless, much of its phase diagram remains controversial.

arxiv-2106-11787.title: Automated matching of two-time X-ray photon correlation maps from protein dynamics with Cahn-Hilliard type simulations using autoencoder networks
arxiv-2106-11787.creator: Sonja Timmermann, Vladimir Starostin, Anita Girelli, Anastasia Ragulskaya, Hendrik Rahmann, Mario Reiser, Nafisa Begam, Lisa Randolph, Michael Sprung, Fabian Westermeier, Fajun Zhang, Frank Schreiber, Christian Gutt
arxiv-2106-11787.description: Abstract We use machine learning methods for an automated classification of experimental XPCS two-time correlation functions from an arrested liquid-liquid phase separation of a protein solution. We couple simulations based on the Cahn-Hilliard equation with a glass transition scenario and classify the measured correlation maps automatically according to quench depth and critical concentration at a glass/gel transition.

arxiv-2204-02575.title: On a rainbow extremal problem for color-critical graphs
arxiv-2204-02575.creator: Debsoumya Chakraborti, Jaehoon Kim, Hyunwoo Lee, Hong Liu, Jaehyeon Seo
arxiv-2204-02575.description: Abstract There has been extensive studies on the following question: given k k graphs G 1 , … , G k G_{1},\dots,G_{k} over a common vertex set of size n n , what conditions on G i G_{i} ensures a ‘colorful’ copy of H H , i.e.

arxiv-2206-11159.title: On Clique Version of the Randic Index
arxiv-2206-11159.creator: Hossein Teimoori Faal
arxiv-2206-11159.description: Abstract . In this paper, we first review the weighted-version of the handshaking lemma based on the idea of a weighted vertex-edge incidence matrix of a given graph G G . Then, we obtain a generalized version of the handshaking lemma based on the concept of the clique value. We also define a generalized version of Randic index.

arxiv-2207-04246.title: On holonomy groupoid of vertex operator algebra bundles on foliations
arxiv-2207-04246.creator: A. Zuevsky
arxiv-2207-04246.description: Abstract . For a foliation ℱ \mathcal{F} defined on a smooth complex manifold M M we introduce the category of vertex operator algebra V V bundles with sections provided by vectors of elements of the space of algebraically extended V V -module W W -valued differentials. An intrinsic coordinate-independent formulation for such bundles is given.

arxiv-2304-00983.title: Modelling Maritime SAR Effective Sweep Widths for Helicopters in VDM
arxiv-2304-00983.creator: Alexander Sulaiman, Ken Pierce
arxiv-2304-00983.description: Abstract Search and Rescue (SAR) is searching for and providing help to people in danger. In the UK, SAR teams are typically charities with limited resources, and SAR missions are time critical. Search managers need to objectively decide which search assets (e.g. helicopter vs drone) would be better.

arxiv-2305-10305.title: Effects of Kaluza-Klein Neutrinos on R D R_{D} and R D ∗ R_{D^{*}}
arxiv-2305-10305.creator: Janus Capellan Aban, Chuan-Ren Chen, Chrisna Setyo Nugroho
arxiv-2305-10305.description: Abstract Recent measurements of R D R_{D} and R D ∗ R_{D^{*}} by the LHCb collaboration show deviations from their respective Standard Model values. These semileptonic B B meson decays, associated with b → c ​ τ ​ ν ¯ b\rightarrow c\tau\bar{\nu} transition, are pointing toward new physics beyond the Standard Model via leptonic flavor universality violation.

arxiv-2310-07325.title: An Adversarial Example for Direct Logit Attribution: Memory Management in GELU-4L
arxiv-2310-07325.creator: Jett Janiak, Can Rager, James Dao, Yeu-Tong Lau
arxiv-2310-07325.description: Abstract Prior work suggests that language models manage the limited bandwidth of the residual stream through a "memory management" mechanism, where certain attention heads and MLP layers clear residual stream directions set by earlier layers. Our study provides concrete evidence for this erasure phenomenon in a 4-layer transformer, identifying heads that consistently remove the output of earlier heads.

arxiv-2311-07579.title: Relative intrinsic dimensionality is intrinsic to learning
arxiv-2311-07579.creator: Oliver J. Sutton 1, Qinghua Zhou 1, Alexander N. Gorban 2, Ivan Y. Tyukin 1
arxiv-2311-07579.description: Abstract . High dimensional data can have a surprising property: pairs of data points may be easily separated from each other, or even from arbitrary subsets, with high probability using just simple linear classifiers. However, this is more of a rule of thumb than a reliable property as high dimensionality alone is neither necessary nor sufficient for successful learning.

arxiv-2312-13784.title: Benchmarking Evolutionary Community Detection Algorithms in Dynamic Networks
arxiv-2312-13784.creator: Giordano Paoletti, Luca Gioacchini, Marco Mellia, Luca Vassio, Jussara M. Almeida
arxiv-2312-13784.description: Abstract In dynamic complex networks, entities interact and form network communities that evolve over time. Among the many static Community Detection (CD) solutions, the modularity-based Louvain, or Greedy Modularity Algorithm (GMA), is widely employed in real-world applications due to its intuitiveness and scalability.

arxiv-2403-10784.title: Identifying Optimal Launch Sites of High-Altitude Latex-Balloons using Bayesian Optimisation for the Task of Station-Keeping
arxiv-2403-10784.creator: Jack Saunders, Sajad Saeedi, Adam Hartshorne, Binbin Xu, Özgür Şimşek, Alan Hunter, Wenbin Li
arxiv-2403-10784.description: Abstract Station-keeping tasks for high-altitude balloons show promise in areas such as ecological surveys, atmospheric analysis, and communication relays. However, identifying the optimal time and position to launch a latex high-altitude balloon is still a challenging and multifaceted problem. For example, tasks such as forest fire tracking place geometric constraints on the launch location of the balloon.

arxiv-2404-01002.title: Study of Curved Domain-wall Fermions on a Lattice
arxiv-2404-01002.creator: Shoto Aoki
arxiv-2404-01002.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shoto Aoki. In this thesis, we consider fermion systems on square lattice spaces with a curved domain-wall mass term. In a similar way to the flat case, we find massless and chiral states localized at the wall. In the case of S 1 S^{1} and S 2 S^{2} domain-wall embedded into a square lattice, we find that these edge states feel gravity through the induced spin connection.

arxiv-2407-01676.title: Axion Relic Pockets — a theory of dark matter
arxiv-2407-01676.creator: Pierluca Carenza, Joshua Eby, Oksana Iarygina, M.C. David Marsh
arxiv-2407-01676.description: Abstract We propose a new theory of dark matter based on axion physics and cosmological phase transitions. We show that theories in which a gauge coupling increases through a first-order phase transition naturally result in ‘axion relic pockets’: regions of relic false vacua stabilised by the pressure from a kinematically trapped, hot axion gas.

arxiv-2407-17042.title: The Hessian of elliptic curves as a Lattès map
arxiv-2407-17042.creator: Marzio Mula, Federico Pintore, Daniele Taufer
arxiv-2407-17042.description: Abstract We prove that the Hessian transformation of elliptic curves, both as an action on j j -invariants and on the Hesse pencil, is a rigid Lattès map fitting into a reduced diagram, hence it lifts to a degree- 3 3 endomorphism ψ \psi of a prescribed elliptic curve E E .

arxiv-2408-04539.title: ParetoTracker: Understanding Population Dynamics in Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithms through Visual Analytics
arxiv-2408-04539.creator: Zherui Zhang, Fan Yang, Ran Cheng, Senior Member, IEEE, and Yuxin Ma, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2408-04539.description: Abstract Multi-objective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) have emerged as powerful tools for solving complex optimization problems characterized by multiple, often conflicting, objectives. While advancements have been made in computational efficiency as well as diversity and convergence of solutions, a critical challenge persists: the internal evolutionary mechanisms are opaque to human users.

arxiv-2503-23848.title: SpeechDialogueFactory: Generating High-Quality Speech Dialogue Data to Accelerate Your Speech-LLM Development
arxiv-2503-23848.creator: Minghan Wang, Ye Bai, Yuxia Wang, Thuy-Trang Vu, Ehsan Shareghi, Gholamreza Haffari
arxiv-2503-23848.description: Abstract High-quality speech dialogue datasets are crucial for Speech-LLM development, yet existing acquisition methods face significant limitations. Human recordings incur high costs and privacy concerns, while synthetic approaches often lack conversational authenticity. To address these challenges, we introduce SpeechDialogueFactory , a production-ready framework for generating natural speech dialogues efficiently.

arxiv-2602-04153.title: Pruning for Generalization: A Transfer-Oriented Spatiotemporal Graph Framework
arxiv-2602-04153.creator: 1 st Zihao Jing, 2 nd Yuxi Long, 3 rd Ganlin Feng
arxiv-2602-04153.description: Abstract Multivariate time series forecasting in graph-structured domains is critical for real-world applications, yet existing spatiotemporal models often suffer from performance degradation under data scarcity and cross-domain shifts. We address these challenges through the lens of structure-aware context selection. We propose TL-GPSTGN , a transfer-oriented spatiotemporal framework that enhances sample efficiency and out-of-distribution generalization by selectively pruning non-optimized graph context.

britannica-1911-athabasca.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-athabasca.description: Article 'Athabasca' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Slave, which drains the lake of that name, and Clearwater. Athabasca lake is 195 m. long, west to east, from 20 to 32 m. wide has an area of 3085 sq. It discharges its waters northward by Slave river and the Mackenzie system to the Arctic Ocean. On its north shore the country is high and rocky; on the south, sandy and barren.

pmc-10613375.title: Prognostic value of ascites in patients with liver cirrhosis undergoing cardiac surgery
pmc-10613375.creator: Amila Cizmic, Parwis Baradaran Rahmanian, Asmae Gassa, Elmar Kuhn, Navid Mader, Thorsten Wahlers
pmc-10613375.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionMild or moderate liver cirrhosis increases the risk of complications after cardiac surgery. Ascites is the most common complication associated with liver cirrhosis. However, the prognostic value of ascites on postoperative morbidity and mortality after cardiac surgery remains uninvestigated.MethodsA retrospective study included 69 patients with preoperatively diagnosed liver cirrhosis who underwent cardiac surgery between January 2009 and January 2018 at the Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery, University Hospital of Cologne, Germany.

pmc-11425702.title: Characterization of flare-ups and impact of garetosmab in adults with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva: a post hoc analysis of the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled LUMINA-1 trial
pmc-11425702.creator: Richard Keen, Kathryn M Dahir, Jennifer McGinniss, Robert J Sanchez, Scott Mellis, Aris N Economides, Maja Di Rocco, Philippe Orcel, Christian Roux, Jacek Tabarkiewicz, Javier Bachiller-Corral, Angela M Cheung, Mona Al Mukaddam, Kusha Mohammadi, Jing Gu, Dushyanth Srinivasan, Dinko Gonzalez Trotter,
pmc-11425702.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP) is an ultra-rare disorder, characterized by progressive heterotopic ossification (HO) and painful soft-tissue inflammatory flare-ups. This was a post hoc analysis from a phase 2 (NCT03188666) trial in which adults with FOP received intravenous anti-activin A antibody garetosmab 10 mg/kg or placebo every 4 wk over 28 wk (Period 1), followed by a 28-wk open-label treatment and extension (Periods 2 and 3).

pmc-11428424.title: Effect of Urolithin A on Bovine Sperm Capacitation and In Vitro Fertilization
pmc-11428424.creator: Manuela Jorge, Filipa C. Ferreira, Carla C. Marques, Maria C. Batista, Paulo J. Oliveira, F. Lidon, Sofia C. Duarte, José Teixeira, Rosa M. L. N. Pereira
pmc-11428424.description: Simple SummarySperm cells are specialized cells that are highly susceptible to different kinds of damage, impairing the success of in vitro fertilization and, consequently, of assisted reproductive techniques (ART). Oxidative stress plays a significant role in this context causing DNA injury, reduced motility, and compromising the fertilization ability of sperm.

pmc-11436867.title: Effect of natural aging on biochar physicochemical property and mobility of Cd (II)
pmc-11436867.creator: Cenwei Liu, Jing Ye, Yi Lin, Xiaomei Wu, G W Price, Yixiang Wang
pmc-11436867.description: This project utilized both field experiment and laboratory analyses to address the gap in understanding regarding the alterations in properties and functions of biochar, and the impact of heavy metal passivation in soil over long-term natural field aging. The study aimed to examine the changes in the physical and chemical characteristics of biochar over an extended period of natural aging.

pmc-11532455.title: Watchful waiting in laryngo‐tracheobronchial amyloid: A case report
pmc-11532455.creator: Dylan Beinart, Siaw Ming Chai, Olivia Walsh, Sanjay Ramakrishnan, John Blakey
pmc-11532455.description: We report the long term follow up of a now 66‐year‐old male with laryngo‐tracheobronchial amyloidosis. The patient initially presented with dysphonia and dyspnoea. He was diagnosed with laryngeal reflux and asthma. Seven years later, the patient underwent cross sectional thoracic imaging showing diffuse thickening of the distal trachea and proximal main bronchi.

pmc-12609213.title: The Role of COL6A3 in Tumorigenesis, Metastasis, Diagnosis, and Disease Management
pmc-12609213.creator: Joshua J. Lingo, Maggie M. Balas, Philipp E. Scherer, Jason C. Klein
pmc-12609213.description: Simple SummaryCollagens are the most abundant proteins expressed in the human body and are a vital component of the extracellular matrix (ECM). Originally the ECM was thought to provide structural support to tissues. Over the past few decades, the ECM has also been implicated in cell signaling, tumor growth, and therapy resistance.

pmc-12630392.title: Public Health Insights from Social Media Analysis during the COVID-19 Pandemic in South Korea
pmc-12630392.creator: Seungeun Park, Taemin Song, Jae-Hyun Park
pmc-12630392.description: regarding guidelines and recommendations and provide messages to mitigate actions responding to public health emergencies (3). An analysis of social media data can potentially extract pertinent situational insights. Such situational insights hold significant value for public health professionals and decision-makers, helping them devise more efficient crisis response strategies (4,5).

pmc-13246921.title: Prognostic, diagnostic and therapeutic value of the cancer tubulin code
pmc-13246921.creator: Carolina Vilela, Daniela Gomes-Andrade, Sónia Silva, Helder Maiato
pmc-13246921.description: Microtubules are essential cytoskeleton polymers composed of α/β-tubulin heterodimers that play a central role in the regulation of various cellular processes, including cell division, cell shape, cell polarity, motility and intracellular trafficking. The expression of different tubulin genes results in a variety of isotypes that, combined with post-translational modifications (PTMs), define a “tubulin code” that generates microtubule diversity.

pmc-13278748.title: Accuracy of Quantifying Hypotension During Surgery Using Physiological Sensor Data
pmc-13278748.creator: Martin Jacobsson, Arman Valadkhani, Greg Winski, Max Bell
pmc-13278748.description: Objective: During surgery it is common to measure the arterial blood pressure. One important reason is to monitor for hypotension, a too low blood pressure, which is known to be harmful. Since post-surgical complications correlate with hypotension, it is common to calculate the number of hypotensive events, their cumulative length, or their cumulative area under threshold.

pmc-13653053.title: Patient reported outcomes and return to play after arthroscopic hip labral reconstruction in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13653053.creator: Deniz C Ince, Kyle P O’Connor, Mia S Hagen, John C Clohisy, Jeffrey J Nepple
pmc-13653053.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Femoroacetabular impingement is a common cause of labral damage and hip pain in athletes. In severe labral tears with inadequate healthy labrum for repair, labral reconstruction has shown positive clinical outcomes in the general population. This study aimed to conduct a systematic review and meta-analysis on athletes undergoing arthroscopic hip labral reconstruction, focusing on postoperative patient-reported outcomes (PROs) and return to play (RTP).
